assessments.reasoning: The data model gives implementations discretion to delay or entirely omit collection after an object becomes unreachable. It expressly requires reachable objects to survive collection.

challenge.method: Check whether the CPython reference-counting example requires prompt collection or whether a debugger-held object is a counterexample.
challenge.results: The CPython example describes one implementation. A debugger reference can preserve reachability. Neither case changes the rule or establishes a finalization deadline.

limitations: This is a language-reference description of permitted collection behavior. CPython's collector details and finalization timing are separate.
No timing is inferred for other runtimes, all CPython objects, or external resource cleanup.
Runtime observations use the installed CPython 3.13.5 Windows build. The documentation scope comes from the pinned 3.13.0 source.
